title: Integrated announcement sprint plan and release-notes sync for Dedicated Autoscaling beta
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Coordinate a single, low-friction announcement across blog, customer email, social, docs, and a technical webinar for the Dedicated Autoscaling beta. Goals: 1) Drive signup funnel for Dedicated trials; 2) Provide clear rollout and release-notes for existing Dedicated customers; 3) Surface migration guidance for Dedicated -> Private customers. Scope: blog post, release notes, two customer emails (beta invite + GA-readiness update), three social posts (Twitter/LinkedIn/Developer X), docs release notes page, webinar (technical deep-dive + Q&A), assets (images, sample config snippets, migration checklist). This ticket owns timing, cross-team signoffs, and the release-notes canonical copy. Success metrics: 5% conversion on beta CTAs from blog, 300 webinar registrants, release-notes page 90% coverage of known breaking/behavioral changes, and zero critical support escalations in first week post-announcement.
